unsupported: The business was founded by David Lewis after he discovered a passion for fine woodworking while attending the Vermont Woodworking School.
A native of Lutherville, Maryland, Lewis spent childhood summers in Vermont’s Green Mountains and now lives in Essex with his family, running the shop as a solo craftsman.
Clients are typically individual homeowners seeking one-of-a-kind tables, dressers, beds, and decorative items such as Kumiko lanterns.
There is no standard product line; every item is made to order.
